  Something that was judged finished and is being left alone anyway.

  type                        string, one of:
    worktree                  A checkout with a directory of its own, which has to be
                              left before it can be removed.
    branch                    A branch with no worktree, which needs no evacuation.
  target                      string
  branch                      string (absent when empty)
                              Absent for a bare branch, whose name is already the
                              target.
  reason                      string, one of:
    uncommitted_changes       Work that exists nowhere but this checkout.
    unpushed_commits          Work that exists nowhere but this clone.
    no_upstream_with_commits  A branch with commits and nowhere to have pushed them,
                              which the unpushed check cannot see because it needs an
                              upstream to compare against.
    commits_beyond_merged_pr  A branch pushed to after its pull request merged, or
                              diverged from it, or whose merged head is not here at all.
                              Nothing else catches it: the commits are on the remote, so
                              every unpushed check passes and `git branch -d` agrees to
                              delete. detail lists the commits beyond the merge, or says
                              the merged head is missing locally where that is why.
    local_commits_beyond_pr   A branch whose pull request closed unmerged and which
                              carries commits the pull request never had.
    in_use_by_process         A worktree some process is still standing in — another
                              Claude Code session, a shell. detail names the process and
                              its pid. The worktree the caller is standing in is exempt
                              from the check and becomes an is_current candidate
                              instead.
  detail                      string
